_about: Ethanol (1) + water (2): isobaric T-x-y at 101.3 kPa, binary data set from Kamihama et al. (2012). Rows as in the ThermoML Archive record: liquid mole fraction of ethanol, boiling temperature in K, vapour mole fraction of ethanol.

source.citation: N. Kamihama, H. Matsuda, K. Kurihara, K. Tochigi, S. Oba, Isobaric Vapor-Liquid Equilibria for Ethanol + Water + Ethylene Glycol and Its Constituent Three Binary Systems, J. Chem. Eng. Data 57 (2012) 339-344
source.access: Journal article is subscription-only; the same data is public in the NIST TRC ThermoML Archive (NIST open license).
source.tables: ThermoML record, PureOrMixtureData 4 (boiling temperature) and 5 (vapour mole fraction): the binary ethanol + water set. The table number in the article was not checked (article not open).

notes: Expanded uncertainties per point in the ThermoML record: T from 1.76 K (x_1 = 0.018) to 0.09 K (x_1 >= 0.8), y_1 from 0.056 to 0.015. No pure-component rows in the set; the record also gives vapour pressures of ethanol and water (not used). The ThermoML record carries no consistency-test result; validation/python/fit_parameters.py runs a point test and prints it. Read twice from the ThermoML Archive (XML and JSON files), both reads identical.
